title: Late Night Secret Meeting
next_chapter_hook: The moment Chen Ji decided to trust Su Qingyao, the three Heavenly Fate Values on the Tianji Record Fragment quietly ignited—within three days, the Tianqing Sect would face a upheaval that would overturn all schemes.

text.content: The deep night Tianqing Sect was silent, only the distant watch-drum beating against the沉闷 night. Su Qingyao quietly arrived outside Chen Ji's secluded Servants' Quarters, clutching the Jade Slip that could shake the entire sect, her fingertips slightly pale. Under the moonlight, that always-cold face unexpectedly showed a rare hesitation. The mottled wooden door of the Servants' Quarters was tightly closed, a sliver of dim candlelight leaking through the crack. She took a deep breath and finally knocked on the door. Three knocks, neither light nor heavy, yet carrying an indescribable solemnity.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su visits so late—isn't this the wrong road?" A languid voice came from inside, the wooden door creaking open to reveal Chen Ji's face, so ordinary it was nearly mediocre. He rubbed his eyes, looking dazed from being woken, "Or could it be that Inner Disciples also want to experience the simple hardships of servants?"

Su Qingyao's gaze slightly condensed, noticing an unnoticeable crease at the corner of Chen Ji's robe—that was left from meditation. She didn't expose him, only taking the Jade Slip from her sleeve, voice extremely low: "Less nonsense. I have important matters to discuss." Her gaze quickly swept the surroundings, confirming no one was watching before she squeezed through the door crack, "Inside. Now."

text.content: The Servants' Quarters was barely a zhang in size, the furnishings简陋得近乎寒酸: a wooden board bed, a worn writing desk, a few scrolls of yellowed cultivation manual fragments piled in the corner. Yet Su Qingyao noticed the oil lamp flame on the desk was flickering slightly, as if under its master's deliberate suppression it maintained some eerie rhythm. She closed the door behind her, the candlelight suddenly dimming.

dialogue.content: "This is the transfer order personally approved by Sect Master Ling Yuan." Su Qingyao handed the Jade Slip to Chen Ji, her voice pressing down barely concealable trembling, "Three days later, the eve of the Sect Competition, the Tianqing Sect will announce a major decision—abolishing the Servants' Quarters system, all Servant Disciples will be uniformly incorporated into the Outer Court." She paused, a chill flickering in her eyes, "Surface mercy, reality purge."

text.content: Chen Ji took the Jade Slip, and the instant his fingertips touched that cold jade surface, the Tianji Record Fragment in his mental sea violently trembled. Countless runes flooded into his sight like a tide—that was Ling Yuan's personally carved formation array, layered upon layers, with seven seals. His lips slightly curved upward, already having a plan. The Breaking Formation Eyes quietly operated, first layer piercing illusion, second layer analyzing formation, third layer... discerning.

dialogue.content: "Seven seals, three layers of prohibition, two hidden gates." Chen Ji casually set the Jade Slip on the desk, his tone light and casual, "Sect Master Ling fears someone might alter this 'mercy decree,' sparing no expense." He raised his eyes to look at Su Qingyao, and those seemingly murky eyes suddenly flickered with brilliant light, "But Senior Sister Su, are you certain this is a purge list, rather than... an invitation?"

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply, instinctively stepping back half a pace: "What did you say?" Her voice suddenly rose, "Chen Ji, who exactly are you? This formation even I can barely sense the first layer—how could you—" Before finishing, she suddenly realized her loss of composure, forcibly suppressing the churning waves, gritting her teeth, "You've been hiding your true abilities all along."

text.content: The third layer ability of the Breaking Formation Eyes was like an invisible scalpel, dissecting every prohibition within the Jade Slip, every trace of Spiritual Energy flow, completely clear. Chen Ji saw Ling Yuan's true intention carved deep within the Jade Slip—it wasn't a purge list, but a special "invitation." Anyone whose name was on it would, three days later, enter the sect's Forbidden Grounds "Qingyun Pavilion" to comprehend the sect-guarding cultivation art. And Qingyun Pavilion was precisely one of the entrances to the Ancient Forbidden Land.

dialogue.content: "Hiding abilities?" Chen Ji chuckled lightly, turning to rummage through the worn writing desk, producing a chipped teapot, his movements unhurried as if strolling in his own backyard, "Senior Sister Su came so late at night, surely not specifically to expose my secrets." He poured two cups of cold tea, pushing one toward Su Qingyao, "Tell me, what exactly are you investigating? An insider? Ling Yuan? Or... what in this sect is even unknown to the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow?"

text.content: Su Qingyao didn't take the teacup, that cold and beautiful face appearing especially pallid in the dim candlelight. After a long silence, she suddenly lifted the corner of her outer robe, revealing a badge embroidered with subtle patterns on her inner lining—the emblem of the Tianqing Sect's Law Enforcement Hall. "I've been investigating for three months." Her voice was like something squeezed through her teeth, "In three months, seven disciples have gone missing from the sect—all servants and outer disciples."

dialogue.content: "The Law Enforcement Hall has closed the case, saying they privately descended the mountain and encountered demon beasts." Su Qingyao coldly laughed, but the笑意 didn't reach her eyes, "But I checked the archives—the soul lamps of those seven never extinguished. The disappearance isn't death, but being taken somewhere." She stared at Chen Ji, her gaze burning, "And you, Chen Ji—you should have been on that list, but a month ago your name was deliberately crossed out."

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao laid all her cards on the table, Chen Ji faced a critical choice—whether to be honest for trust, or keep some secrets to maintain initiative?

choices.description: Reveal part of the truth to Su Qingyao, demonstrate some of the Tianji Record's abilities, exchange for her initial trust, while keeping the most core secrets.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's trust, intelligence sharing
choices.risk_hint: Risk being seen through for more flaws

text.content: Chen Ji lifted the teacup and gently sipped, that ordinary face showing a meaningful smile. "Senior Sister Su is indeed sharp." He set down the teacup, fingertips tapping lightly on the desk three times, "You're right, the list was indeed tampered with. And the reason I was crossed out is because... someone wanted to protect me."

choices.description: Persist in thetrash persona, don't easily reveal flaws, while extracting more information about the insider and Law Enforcement Hall through dialogue.

text.content: Chen Ji set down the teacup, that playful smile gradually fading, replaced by a fitting confusion. "List? Crossed out?" He scratched his head, tone carrying fitting bewilderment, "Senior Sister Su, aren't you overestimating me? Atrash like me, what qualifications do I have to be on any list..."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's gaze suddenly sharpened, she stepped forward, almost face to face with Chen Ji: "Chen Ji, I don't have time to beat around the bush with you!" Her voice was pressed extremely low, yet carried an unquestionable pressure, "Three months ago you fell off the Rear Mountain cliff—that night Law Enforcement Hall people were nearby; two months ago you saw something you shouldn't have at the scripture library, the next day Ling Yuan personally 'visited' you; a month ago your name was crossed off the list—do you think all these are coincidences?"

text.content: The candle flame suddenly trembled, Chen Ji stared into Su Qingyao's eyes, seeing not doubt, but a near stubborn steadfastness. This woman was more troublesome than he imagined—she wasn't here to interrogate him, but to declare her position. The Breaking Formation Eyes quietly operated, he caught an almost imperceptible fluctuation deep within Su Qingyao's pupils: she was gambling. Betting he was worth it, betting she hadn't chosen wrong.

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su investigated very thoroughly." Chen Ji suddenly smiled, that smile having less cynicism, more rare seriousness, "But you missed one thing—why would you think I'm someone worth trusting?" He pointed to his own face, so mediocre it was extreme, "trash, servant, life like grass. You're Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, I'm a person everyone shouts to drive away. You and I working together—if word gets out, your reputation would be ruined."

"Reputation?" Su Qingyao snorted coldly, that cold and beautiful face showing rare sarcasm, "Three months ago Law Enforcement Hall people asked me—why didn't those seven missing disciples' soul lamps extinguish? You know how they made me shut up?" She took out a token from her sleeve, clearly inscribed with the character "Ling", "Sect Master Ling Yuan personally gave me an out. He told me not to meddle, otherwise the next to disappear would be me."

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan's true face revealed, Su Qingyao has declared allegiance. Chen Ji needs to decide whether to open cooperation completely.

choices.description: Show Su Qingyao the true power of the Breaking Formation Eyes, tell her part of the truth about the Tianji Record, formally form an alliance.
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao betrays, it will be utter destruction

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, finally making that decision. "Senior Sister Su, since we've chosen to advance and retreat together—" He extended his palm, the Tianji Record Fragment faintly glowing in his mental sea, he slowly closed his eyes—then opened them again, his pupils now carrying a faint golden hue, "Perhaps... I can show you what Senior Sister Su wants to see." His voice was low and calm, "But before that, I need you to swear—tonight's matters, never to be spread."

choices.description: Don't completely refuse cooperation, but also don't expose too many trump cards. Maintain an ambiguous relationship, waiting for a better opportunity.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may turn and leave

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his hand, expression recovering its usual calm bordering on coldness. "I appreciate Senior Sister Su's intentions, but the alliance matter... let me think about it." He turned to take a yellowed bamboo scroll from the corner, the most basic Qi Refining manual of Tianqing Sect, "Three days later at the Sect Competition, it's not too late to decide then." His tone was unhurried, "Senior Sister Su might as well tell me—among those seven missing disciples, is there anyone you know?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao's gaze flickered slightly, Chen Ji's probe hitting her most unwilling-to-mention soft spot. After a long silence, she finally spoke, voice carrying a trembling she herself hadn't noticed: "There is. Lin Xiaodie, Outer Disciple, three years ago she saved my life during training." She tightly gripped her sleeve, knuckles white, "She's not an important person, just... a silly girl who would secretly send me pastries on my birthday."

text.content: Candlelight wavered, casting shifting shadows on Chen Ji's face. He looked at the fleeting vulnerability in Su Qingyao's eyes, and somewhere in his heart a string was gently plucked. At this moment he suddenly realized—this seemingly cold and proud Inner Disciple Senior Fellow was merely a pitiful person caught up in sect conspiracies. The Tianji Record Fragment in his mental sea faintly trembled, seemingly urging him to make some decision. He suddenly spoke: "Lin Xiaodie... was her birthday March ninth?"

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao abruptly raised her head, eyes flashing an incredulous light: "How... how do you know?" Her voice suddenly rose, "No one else besides me has ever—" Halfway through, she suddenly realized something, pupils contracting, "It's you! You saw her name on the list? You know where she is?"

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer, but raised his palm. The Tianji Record Fragment slowly unfolded in his mental sea, golden light reflecting through his pupils, forming a hazy light screen before Su Qingyao. In the screen could be vaguely seen a deep underground palace, seven figures chained and imprisoned on stone pillars, among which one slender silhouette resembled Lin Xiaodie. "When Qingyun Pavilion opens in three days, that's when they will make their move." Chen Ji's voice was calm as water, "Senior Sister Su, you still have a chance to withdraw."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao stared at that familiar silhouette in the screen, eye sockets slightly reddening. Three years ago during training when danger struck, it was Lin Xiaodie who used her meager cultivation to block a deadly blow for her. Now this silly girl was trapped deep in the underground palace, yet she was helpless—this thought nearly suffocated her. After a moment, she abruptly raised her head, vulnerability in her eyes replaced by determination: "I won't withdraw." Her voice rang out, "From tonight forward, I Su Qingyao advance and retreat with you Chen Ji. If Ling Yuan wants to touch them, he'll have to step over my corpse first."

text.content: In the deep night Servants' Quarters, candle flames flickered. Chen Ji and Su Qingyao stood facing each other—one seemingly ordinarytrash servant, the other an unreachable Inner Disciple Senior Fellow. Two people of heaven-and-earth differing status, yet standing on the same boat due to a common goal. Just then, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly sent a violent tremor—not an omen, but a warning. Chen Ji's expression slightly changed, the Breaking Formation Eyes third layer instantly operating at maximum, a blurry image forming in his mind: three days later, inside Qingyun Pavilion, blood light shooting into the sky.

choice.prompt: The Tianji Record issued a warning—the Qingyun Pavilion visit three days later is extremely dangerous. Chen Ji needs to decide how to respond to the coming crisis.

choices.text: Tell Su Qingyao all the truth
choices.description: Tell Su Qingyao everything about the Tianji Record, Breaking Formation Eyes, and Ling Yuan's conspiracy, both of them plan countermeasures together.
choices.visible_reward: Gain Su Qingyao's full support, co-plan together
choices.risk_hint: If Su Qingyao betrays, it will be utter destruction

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, finally making that decision. "Senior Sister Su, since we've chosen to advance and retreat together—" He extended his palm, the Tianji Record Fragment emerging from his palm, golden light flowing between the two, "Then there are some things you must know." His voice was low and solemn, "About Ling Yuan, about Qingyun Pavilion, about... why I was on that list."

choices.description: Only tell Su Qingyao about the danger in three days, let her coordinate actions, but keep the core secrets about the Tianji Record.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot gain Su Qingyao's full cooperation

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew the Tianji Record Fragment, his expression returning to its usual calm. "Qingyun Pavilion will have trouble in three days." He said briefly, "At that time you only need to do one thing—when I need it, stall Ling Yuan for a quarter hour." He paused, tone carrying unquestionable certainty, "Everything else, you don't need to know too much."

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao was silent for a moment, seemingly absorbing the weight in Chen Ji's words. After a long while, she suddenly laughed lightly, that laugh carrying a hint of self-mockery: "Chen Ji, you really are... hard to figure out." She raised her hand to tidy the stray hair at her temple, recovering that cold and composed appearance, "Fine, whatever you say goes. After all from tonight forward, my Su Qingyao's life is in your hands—just hope you don't disappoint me."

text.content: Outside the window the night was deep, the watch-drum sounded again, foretelling this long night was about to end. Su Qingyao rose to take her leave, before departing she suddenly looked back at Chen Ji: "By the way, something I almost forgot to tell you—three days ago Ye Qing appeared near the sect." Her voice was pressed extremely low, "The Holy Sect's Saint appearing suddenly in Central Zhou is probably not a good omen. You... be careful." With that, she pushed open the door and departed, her figure quickly disappearing into the night.

The door closed, Chen Ji stood alone under that dim oil lamp, expression complex. Su Qingyao's words echoed in his mind—Ye Qing, that Holy Sect's Saint, why would she appear near Tianqing Sect at this time? Could it be she received his message and came specially? The Tianji Record Fragment in his mental sea faintly burned hot, that prophecy about three days later growing increasingly clear: blood light shooting into the sky at Qingyun Pavilion, the underground palace imprisoning seven people, and... a demonic shadow hidden in the darkness. The situation was more complicated than he imagined.

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, the runes on the Tianji Record Fragment flickering in the darkness. Three days later at Qingyun Pavilion would be the beginning of the largest chess game he had set up. Su Qingyao's addition added some variables to this game—but also more chance of victory. His lips slightly curved upward, murmuring to himself: "Ling Yuan ah Ling Yuan, you think everything is under your control, but you don't know... the chess game has already reversed." As his words fell, the candle flame abruptly extinguished, the Servants' Quarters falling into darkness. Yet just in this darkness, Chen Ji's eyes were startlingly bright—that was the unique light of a Chess Player.
